info.title: Inrepli REST API
info.description: API 1.1 exposes eight CRM operations under /v1. Authenticate using a tenant-scoped Bearer API key. Successful reads cost 1 RU per request/page; successful PATCH requests, including idempotent replays, cost 2 RU; failures cost 0 RU. Maximum 10 requests per API key and 25 per tenant concurrently. Plan quota charging and manual access differ; see the usage guide. Lists are not snapshots or change feeds. Read-only interaction and AI snapshots are not recomputed by PATCH.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor from the preceding page. Preserve filters, q, sort, count and include. Bound to tenant and key scopes; not a snapshot.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Optional complete filtered count.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional case-insensitive substring search of basic identity text, not custom fields or notes. Whitespace is trimmed.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated fields: createdAt, updatedAt, name, lastInteractionAt. Prefix - for descending. Default -createdAt; at most two distinct fields. Server appends id as a tie-breaker; nullable values sort last.

get.description: Requires contacts:read. Returns a cursor page. Query predicates are AND-combined; in matches any listed value. At most 10 predicates, including 3 custom predicates. Dynamic filters use filter[customFields.KEY][operator]; replace KEY with an active definition key. in/hasAny use comma-separated strings (up to 50 values). These dynamic names cannot be enumerated as fixed OpenAPI parameters. See the filtering and custom-fields guides. Fields omitted from list output may still be filtered using supported operators.

patch.description: Requires contacts:write. Requires If-Match and Idempotency-Key. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Returns persisted confirmation, not the full detail. Primary email and mobile are read-only. Omit both from PATCH bodies, including unchanged values and nulls. Supplying either returns 422 CONTACT_IDENTITY_READ_ONLY without applying any changes. Reading and filtering remain supported.
